concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-006 contains placeholder ranges "[deferred] to [deferred]" for the masking proportion and does not specify a concrete acceptable absolute p‑value shift threshold, making the criterion unmeasurable.

Functional Requirement FR-012 also uses placeholder masking proportions "[deferred]–[deferred]" without concrete values, leaving the implementation undefined and conflicting with the need for a measurable success criterion.
